sentences.text: The petitioner is the first accused in C.C. No. 107/2021 on the file of the Court of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ernakulam ('Trial Court', in short), which has originated from Crime No. 1537/2020 registered by the Ernakulam Central Police Station, Ernakulam District, alleging the commission of the offences punishable under Section 10 read with Section 24 of the Emigration Act and Sections 406 and 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Ernakulam Central Police Station, Ernakulam District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. On a perusal of the materials on record, it is seen that pursuant to Annexure A3 order passed by this Court, the petitioner had filed an application for discharge before the Trial Court, which has been dismissed by Annexure A4 order.
Indisputably, an order dismissing the application for discharge is revisable under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
In view of the alternative statutory remedy available to the petitioner, I am not inclined to exercise the inherent powers of this Court under Section 528 of the BNSS.

Resultantly, the Crl.M.C. is dismissed, but by reserving the right of the petitioner to work out his remedies in accordance with law.
Sd/-
